question: What was the percentage growth rate of cash dividends received by Celanese from its ventures in 2013 compared to 2012, given that the company received $92 million in 2013 and $83 million in 2012?
retrieval_query: Celanese cash dividends received 2013 2012 percentage growth rate $92 million $83 million
answer:
Percentage growth rate = ((2013 dividends - 2012 dividends) / 2012 dividends) × 100  
= (($92 million - $83 million) / $83 million) × 100  
= ($9 million / $83 million) × 100  
= 0.1084 × 100  
= 10.84%

Source: finqa_test_ctx_375.pdf p.1
